headline: On last trading day, Sensex crashed 876 points as Nifty fell below 22,900 amid broad selloff

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Wednesday, 21 October.

why: Heavy selling pressure in Private Banking and IT sectors
Negative global cues and a tech-led selloff in Asian markets
Significant wealth erosion with investors losing approximately Rs 5 lakh crore
Sharp declines in major stocks like Infosys, Axis Bank, and Tata Motors
whatHappening: Indian stock markets are closed today, October 20, 2026, in observance of Dussehra
In the last session, the Sensex tumbled 876.37 points to settle at 73,852.90
The Nifty 50 dropped 1.11% to end the previous session at 22,888.95
HFCL reported a massive 448% jump in its Q2 net profit to Rs 394 crore
summary: Indian markets are closed today for Dussehra following a sharp decline in the previous session where the Sensex fell over 870 points. The last session saw significant wealth erosion as IT and private banking stocks dragged the indices below key psychological levels. While most sectors struggled, HFCL stood out with a massive profit surge, and PSU banks showed some resilience during the selloff.
